blockers: codex has required edits: Correct the x86-64 seccomp ABI design: because x32 shares AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64, add a syscall-number guard that rejects every nr carrying __X32_SYSCALL_BIT when x32 is outside the frozen platform envelope, or explicitly filter the complete x32 syscall table. Replace the claim that x32 is killed by the arch check and add an executable x32-numbered bind/listen regression proving denial by the corrected guard. Re-freeze and re-authorize the resulting plan hash.

codex has hard stops: The settled no-listener proof incorrectly treats x32 as a foreign audit architecture. An x32 syscall reports AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64 and is distinguished through __X32_SYSCALL_BIT in seccomp_data.nr; therefore the specified arch gate does not kill it, and x32-encoded bind/listen calls can bypass a denylist matching only native syscall numbers.
